limitations.note: The two-bit counter now wraps correctly after four inputs, but removing the `ready_b` condition changes the first accepted input of a group from adding to `data_out` to overwriting it when `ready_b` is low.

The scoreboard clears its sum after every group regardless of `ready_b`, so the backpressure tests validate the rewrite’s behavior rather than checking that the original accumulation rule was preserved.
